$comment: Vision control variables (C.7), published as vision/variables_spec (IF-07). Names must match shared/interfaces/variables.json. Defaults are STARTING VALUES, tuned in tests. Values from the design document: lost_timeout_ms 200, edit_clear_time_s 1.5, edit_detection_enabled on, edit_min_area_mm2 about 3 x ball area, edit_enter_frames 2, occluded_frames 5, edit_rate_hz 10. HSV ranges use OpenCV units (H 0-179, S and V 0-255). exposure and gain are raw OpenCV camera values; their meaning depends on the camera backend (DirectShow: exposure = log2 of seconds, e.g. -6; V4L2: units of 100 us).

variables.name: camera_index
variables.description: USB camera used by Vision; the camera is reopened. Starts from vision_config.json.

variables.name: ball_diameter_mm
variables.description: Ball size used for detection and the parallax correction; used from the next read_maze.

variables.name: exposure
variables.description: Locked camera exposure (raw OpenCV value, depends on the camera backend).

variables.name: lost_timeout_ms
variables.description: Time without a ball detection before is_visible = false.

variables.name: wall_hit_margin_mm
variables.description: Extra distance allowed when deciding a wall hit.

variables.name: filter_noise
variables.description: Smoothing of the ball filter: lower = smoother, higher = faster reaction.

variables.name: edit_clear_time_s
variables.description: Stillness needed in the playfield before the automatic rescan starts.

variables.name: edit_detection_enabled
variables.description: Hand detection on or off; off = change the maze with Pause, Read maze and Resume.

variables.name: edit_min_area_mm2
variables.description: Smallest changed area that counts as a hand (about 3 x ball area).

variables.name: edit_enter_frames
variables.description: Detector checks in a row before hand_present.

variables.name: occluded_frames
variables.description: Frames in a row with fewer than 4 markers before occluded.

variables.name: edit_rate_hz
variables.description: How often the hand detector runs.

variables.name: wall_hit_min_speed_mm_s
variables.description: Slowest contact speed that counts as a wall hit.
